title: Indlela i-HAX ekhule ngayo
peopleText: Wonke umntu ofake igalelo, ekhula esuka ku-{root}: okukhona ekude, kokukhona ejoyine kamva. Ngamnye ukhazimla ngomsebenzi wakhe wakutshanje (ii-commit kuyo nayiphi na indawo yokugcina ye-HAX, imiba evuliweyo nevaliweyo kuluhlu lwemiba lwe-HAX), eshushu kakhulu xa exakekile, aze aphele kancinci kwiinyanga ezilandelayo.
peopleKey: Ukukhazimla, ukusuka ekuthuleni ukuya kubushushu obumhlophe
selectPerson: Khetha umntu ukuze ubone ukuba wajoyina nini nokuba wenze ntoni.
agentsText: Ii-commit ezibhalwe ziiarhente ze-AI, ezisebenza kwiindawo zokugcina ze-HAX kunye nabantu abazisebenzisayo, ukususela ngo-{date}. Apha zibalwa kunye, hayi njengabantu.
chartHint: Kwisikali se-logarithm, ukunyuka okuthe ngqo kuthetha ukuphindaphindeka okuzinzileyo, kwaye ukugoba ukuya phezulu kuthetha ukuba kuyakhawuleza.
rateThemes: Imixholo emitsha engu-{n} kwiinyanga ezili-12 ukuya ku-{date}: malunga nomnye rhoqo emva kweentsuku ezingu-{days}.
rate30: Imixholo emitsha engu-{n} kwiintsuku ezingama-30 zokugqibela.
noThemes: Akukho mixholo mitsha kwiinyanga ezili-12 ukuya ku-{date}.
preCore: Le mixholo yokuqala ingaphambi kondoqo womxholo owabelwanayo, ofika ngo-{date}; wonke umxholo apha kamva wakhelwe phezu kwawo.
coreText: Wonke umxholo ulayisha undoqo omnye owabelwanayo: {core} nge-gzip kwiifayile ezingu-{files}. Umxholo oqhelekileyo wongeza {own} wawo, malunga ne-{pct}% yondoqo. Iiheksagoni zizotywe ngolo hlobo lwesikali.
themeCost: Utyelelo lokuqala kwisiza se-{name} lulayisha {first}. Emva kokuba undwendwe lubone isiza se-clean-one kumamkeli omnye, kufuneka kuphela u-{after} ongaphezulu.
twoLayers: Wakhelwe phezu kwe-{base}, ngoko usebenzisa kwakhona iileya ezimbini.
newEls: Iipakethe ezintsha ezingu-{n} kwiinyanga ezili-12 ukuya ku-{date}.
elText: Iipakethe ezisetyenziswa kakhulu zihleli embindini; yonke into ejikeleze zona yakhelwe phezu kwazo. Ezisetyenziswe kakhulu ukuya ku-{date}: {top}. Ezingu-{ddd} kwezi pakethe zingu-{n} zakhelwe phezu kwe-DDD. Ubungakanani beheksagoni yifayile ephambili yepakethe nganye, nge-gzip; umda wegolide uphawula iipakethe ezisetyenziswa zezinye ezingama-20 nangaphezulu.
selectElement: Khetha into ukuze ubone ukuba ixhomekeke kuphi (orenji) nokuba yintoni eyisebenzisayo (luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka).
platText: Onke asebenza ngefomathi enye yesiza, i-site.json: amanye aqhuba iisayithi, amanye azakha okanye azihlele, kwaye i-PRAW igcina imithetho yayo.
platKey: Enemibala: iisayithi ezikwibha yenethiwekhi ye-HAX, ngemibala yazo yenethiwekhi. Ngwevu: amaqonga aqhuba nakha i-HAX. Ubungakanani bukhula ngee-commit ukuza kuthi ga ngoku; isangqa siyabetha ngee-commit zenyanga nganye.
selectPlat: Khetha enye ukuze ubone ukuba yenzelwe ntoni.
siteIntro: Undwendwe lufunda amaphepha ambalwa esiza esinye se-HAX, emva koko lufudukele kwisiza esilandelayo kumamkeli omnye. Phakathi kwamaphepha esiza kulandwa kuphela izinto ezongezwa lelo phepha.
themeIntro: Undwendwe luvula isiza se-HAX emva kwesinye kumamkeli omnye, ngasinye sinomxholo owahlukileyo, ngokolandelelwano imixholo eyenziwe ngalo.
firstStep: Iphepha lokuqala le-HAX kumamkeli lilanda yonke into: {need} kwiifayile ezingu-{files}.
laterStep: Eli nyathelo lifuna {need}; u-{cached} wako sele ukwi-cache, ngoko lilanda kuphela u-{fetch}.
unbundled: HAX: iifayile ezingabotshwanga, zigcinwa kwi-cache ngefayile nganye
cacheKey: Iiseli eziorenji zilandwa ngoku, ezegolide bezisele zikwi-cache. Iiseli ezinomda zingundoqo owabelwanayo.
sources: Imihla: xa ifayile nganye yavela kwindlela yayo yangoku, kunye ne-commit yokuqala yendawo yokugcina nganye. Iibhayithi: i-gzip yekhowudi yomthombo yefayile nganye, ifayile ngefayile, ngaphandle kwekhowudi yomntu wesithathu. Iibhrawuza zigcina i-cache enye kwisiza ngasinye, ngoko ukonga phakathi kweesayithi kusebenza kumamkeli omnye.
drawing: {view} ngo-{date}: kuboniswa {n}. Iphaneli ecaleni kwayo idwelisa amanani afanayo.
slowed: Ukudlala kucothiswe izihlandlo ezingama-30 kwinyanga yokugqibela
